images.source_alt: This figure shows three x y-coordinate planes. The first plane shows two lines which intersect at one point. Under the graph it says, “The lines intersect. Intersecting lines have one point in common. There is one solution to this system.” The second x y-coordinate plane shows two parallel lines. Under the graph it says, “The lines are parallel. Parallel lines have no points in common. There is no solution to this system.” The third x y-coordinate plane shows one line. Under the graph it says, “Both equations give the same line. Because we have just one line, there are infinitely many solutions.”

source_discrepancies.treatment: Faithful translated source alt stays traceable; a separate accessible override and note describe the pixels.

source_discrepancies.finding: Indonesian comparison is a 1600x620 RGB redraw with Indonesian labels, not the 791x257 CMYK canonical JPEG.
source_discrepancies.treatment: Serve only the exact canonical JPEG; retain the redraw as comparison evidence.

source_discrepancies.finding: Outline says Roots and Radical while the collection chapter title says Roots and Radicals.
source_discrepancies.treatment: Retain the singular source wording; explain the discrepancy in a separate original note.
Translate the claims and separately state that current availability was not rechecked.

source_discrepancies.finding: Source says three ellipses while the inspected icon visibly contains three dots; icons are static in this reader.
source_discrepancies.treatment: Retain faithful alts; separate accessible overrides describe visible pixels and do not promise controls.

source_discrepancies.finding: Indonesian comparison adds that it is a Bahasa Indonesia translation; canonical English does not.
source_discrepancies.treatment: Do not import the comparison-only phrase; identify the Punjabi adaptation only in a separate original bridge.

source_discrepancies.finding: Canonical literally says odd-numbered questions are provided to students in the Answer Key, although the paragraph otherwise discusses answers.
source_discrepancies.treatment: Keep the faithful source wording and explain the likely question/answer wording tension in a separate original note.

source_discrepancies.finding: Canonical says students solve exponential and logarithmic functions, rather than equations or problems.
source_discrepancies.treatment: Retain the source wording in Punjabi and explain the unusual object of solve in a separate original note.
